findings.desc: doc-internal-inconsistency: docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-experience-layer-execution-plan.md:125-126 — the dev-memory extension instruction lists status states as 'candidate -> active -> stale -> archived', omitting 'proposed', which contradicts line 76 where the canonical L3 lifecycle is defined as 'proposed -> candidate -> active -> stale -> archived'. An implementer extending dev-memory.ts from this instruction could reasonably omit the 'proposed' initial state, producing code inconsistent with the architecture.
